svg.title: Ottodot Trial Booking: Two parents, one seat left: row-locked Postgres transactions, idempotent payments and 34 tests, one of them a real race.
svg.desc: Project card for Ottodot Trial Booking, showing real screenshots of the desktop and mobile layouts. Two parents, one seat left: row-locked Postgres transactions, idempotent payments and 34 tests, one of them a real race. Built with Next.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Zod, Vitest.
